0.content: Ancient Name (also: Ancient Names, tocaitl, Ancient Name stone, Ancient Name stones, Name bearer, Ancient Name bearer): An Ancient Name (tocaitl) is a title held by certain people of Natlan's six tribes, along with a small obsidian stone that represents it. Each Name stands for a quality such as blessing, devotion or resilience, and carries the remembered deeds of everyone who bore it before. The tribe's guardian spirit, its Wayob, picks who receives one. Before the war ended, bearers were expected to enter the Pilgrimage and to fight the Abyss in the Night Warden Wars.

1.content:
Archon (also: Archons, Hydro Archon): "Archon" is the title of the gods who sit on the seven divine thrones and govern Teyvat's seven nations, together called the Seven or the Seven Archons. Each is tied to an element and an ideal. Barbatos and Morax are the last of the original Seven. As of 7.1 the Hydro throne has been destroyed, so six thrones remain.

The seven: Mondstadt: Barbatos (Venti), Anemo, Freedom. Liyue: Morax (Zhongli), Rex Lapis, Geo, Contracts. Inazuma: Beelzebul, the Raiden Shogun (Ei), Electro, Eternity. Sumeru: Buer, Lesser Lord Kusanali (Nahida), Dendro, Wisdom. Fontaine: Focalors, Hydro, Justice (throne destroyed). Natlan: Haborym, Pyro, War (Mavuika). Snezhnaya: Vassaga, the Tsaritsa, Cryo, Love.

2.content: Archon Names (also: Archon naming, divine name, regnal title, Archon aliases): The Archons have up to three kinds of name: a divine name (Barbatos, Morax, Beelzebul, Buer, Haborym, Vassaga), a regnal title (Rex Lapis, Raiden Shogun, Lesser Lord Kusanali, Tsaritsa) and a personal name (Venti, Zhongli, Ei, Nahida, Mavuika, Anastasya). Barbatos has no regnal title.

3.content:
Fatui Harbinger (also: Harbinger of the Fatui, Fatuus Harbinger, Harbinger seat, Fatui Executive Officer): "Fatui Harbinger" is the title of the eleven top officers of the Fatui, the Tsaritsa's organisation that serves Snezhnaya as both diplomats and military. Each Harbinger heads a division, answers to the Tsaritsa, carries a Delusion and a commedia dell'arte codename (Pierro, Capitano, Dottore and so on), and holds a numbered seat that reflects combat strength. The Fatui's Director, Pierro, leads them. As of 7.1 several seats are dead, resigned or vacant.

Definition: A Harbinger is chosen from the Fatui's eleven most powerful members. On appointment they receive a new name and title, a rank number tied to combat power, and a Delusion. Appointments come from the Tsaritsa, either in person at Zapolyarny Palace or relayed by the Director. Names and titles can be inherited from a previous holder (there have been two Knaves).

4.content:
Grand Sage (also: The Grand Sage): "Grand Sage" is the title of the central leader among the six Great Sages who head the Sumeru Akademiya's Darshans. It is held in addition to leading one Darshan, and the Grand Sage is the absolute leader of the Akademiya. Azar held it until Chapter III; Naphis holds it in the later Sumeru story.

Definition: The Akademiya has Six Great Schools, now nearly the same as the six Darshans, and each is led by one Great Sage. Among these six there is one central leader, the Grand Sage, as Alhaitham explains in A Toast to Victory.

key: Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine
Head Shrine Maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine
5.content:
Guuji (also: Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine, Head Shrine Maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine): Guuji (head priest or priestess of a shrine) is the title of the person who runs the Grand Narukami Shrine, Inazuma's main place of worship of the Electro Archon. The present Guuji is the kitsune Yae Miko, so the word is often used for her directly, as in "Lady Guuji" or "Guuji Yae". She is also editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House.

Holder: Yae Miko, a kitsune of the Hakushin lineage, is the Guuji today and is described as the shrine's most experienced member.

6.content:
Iudex (also: Chief Justice, Iudex Neuvillette): "Iudex" is the title of Fontaine's Chief Justice, the senior judge of the Court of Fontaine. The Iudex presides at the Opera Epiclese, leads the Marechaussee Phantom and has an office in the Palais Mermonia. Neuvillette has held it for more than four hundred years and is seen as the symbol of impartiality.

Definition: The Iudex sits in the judge's seat of the Opera Epiclese on Erinnyes during trials. To the public the job is wearing a wig, keeping order in court and delivering the Oratrice's verdict.

7.content:
Matra and Mahamatra (also: Mahamatra): The Matra are the Sumeru Akademiya's disciplinary officers. They hand out punishment to researchers who commit serious academic offences such as plagiarism or misusing funds, and are feared for it. The General Mahamatra is their leader, a post held by Cyno.

Definition: Once the Matra learn of an offence they visit the offender in person, which is why most meetings with them are known to go poorly. Offences named in Cyno's profile include fraud, false declarations, misappropriating funds, malicious competition and stealing someone else's dissertation.

The general mahamatra: The General Mahamatra is the head of all Matra, in charge of supervising the Akademiya's researchers. Cyno is the current holder. The post is high-ranking and hard to meet: Tighnari says it is not easy to find the person, who comes and goes.

8.content:
Moonchanter: "Moonchanter" is the title of the spiritual leader of the Frostmoon Scions, the Hyperborean-descended tribe of Nod-Krai. The first holder was Aila, about 500 years ago, and the present holder is Lauma, whom her followers call Lady Moonchanter. The Moonchanter speaks for a Moon Goddess who no longer answers prayer.

Definition: The Moonchanter is the head of the Frostmoon Scions' clergy and the person the congregation turns to when they ask when the Goddess of the Frost Moon will answer. Lauma's introduction describes her as the agent of an absent god.

9.content: Nightsoul (also: Nightsoul point): Nightsoul is Natlan's word for the souls that gather in the Night Kingdom, the realm of the dead beneath the land. Living Natlanese warriors can draw on them to move and fight beyond ordinary limits; that is Nightsoul's Blessing.

10.content:
Oculus (also: Oculi, Anemoculus, Anemoculi, Geoculus, Geoculi, Electroculus, Electroculi, Dendroculus): An Oculus (plural Oculi) is a small orb of concentrated elemental energy found in the open world. People with Visions, and the Traveler, collect them and offer them to a Statue of The Seven to restore the statue's lost power and receive its blessing. Each element has its own kind, tied to a nation: Anemoculus (Mondstadt), Geoculus (Liyue), Electroculus (Inazuma), Dendroculus (Sumeru), Hydroculus (Fontaine), Pyroculus (Natlan) and Cryoculus (Snezhnaya).

In universe: In Mondstadt, Paimon explains in the tutorial quest The Blessings of The Seven (1.0) that Anemoculi are consolidated wind that only Vision holders and the Traveler can see. They are offered to the Statues of The Seven in exchange for blessings.

11.content:
Oprichnik (also: Oprichniki, Fatui Oprichnik, Fatui Oprichniki): Oprichnik (plural Oprichniki) is the name for a class of Fatui soldier found across Nod-Krai and Snezhnaya. Unlike the Skirmishers seen abroad, Oprichniki are formally recruited, rigorously trained volunteers, posted to the Fatui's most critical strongholds or thrown into the deadliest frontline battles.

Definition: An Oprichnik is a trained Fatui regular, closer to a professional soldier than to a Skirmisher. The term is used both for the whole group (Oprichniki) and for an individual soldier.

12.content:
Qixing Titles (also: Tianxuan, Tianji, Yaoguang, Seven Stars titles, Qixing seats): The Qixing ("Seven Stars") is Liyue's seven-seat governing committee, and each seat is named for a Big Dipper star: Tianshu, Tianxuan, Tianji, Tianquan, Yuheng, Kaiyang, Yaoguang. Canon uses five. Uncle Tian is Tianshu, Ningguang Tianquan, Keqing Yuheng.

The seven titles: Tianshu: policymaking (Uncle Tian). Tianxuan: holder and duties unknown. Tianji: never shown. Tianquan: laws and foreign relations (Ningguang). Yuheng: land, construction, urban management (Keqing). Kaiyang: unnamed holder. Yaoguang: never shown.

13.content:
Shogun (also: Shogun of Inazuma, Almighty Narukami Ogosho, Great and Excellent Ogosho, Shougun): "Shogun" is the title of Inazuma's supreme ruler, who heads the Inazuma Shogunate and is also the Electro Archon. Makoto (divine name Baal) held it first; her twin Ei took it over about 500 years ago, and Ei has since ruled through a puppet she made, also called the Shogun. Players know the playable character as the Raiden Shogun.

Holders: Makoto, the first Electro Archon, who founded the Shogunate and ruled until she died in the Cataclysm about 500 years ago. Ei, her twin sister, who then took the throne and title. The Shogun, Ei's puppet, who has acted as ruler since about 400 years ago.

14.content:
Starshyna (also: Starshyna of the Lightkeepers, Lightkeeper Starshyna, leader of the Lightkeepers): Starshyna is the title of the leader of the Lightkeepers, the volunteer order that defends Nod-Krai from the Wild Hunt. The first Starshyna was the order's founder, Solovei the Torchforger. As of 7.1 the Starshyna is Nikita, who took the post after his predecessor Sigurd fell fighting the Wild Hunt about a decade earlier.

Definition: The Starshyna is the single head of the Lightkeepers. The post is a leadership one: the holder directs the order's response to Wild Hunt incursions and is the person the Ratniki ultimately answer to.

Holders: Known holders: Solovei the Torchforger (first), Sigurd (previous) and Nikita (current). The wiki also lists the poet Sergei Semyonovich Mayakov as a historical holder.

Event: Alchemical Ascension was a flagship event running from 2024-03-14 to 2024-04-01.

Placement: Follows 4.4 and precedes 4.6.

key: Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
46.comment: Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
46.content:
Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades (also: Version 4.6, Genshin Impact 4.6, 4.6 update): Version 4.6, "Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades", was released on 2024-04-24. It added Arlecchino (5-star Pyro Polearm) and two new areas in Fontaine: the Sea of Bygone Eras and the Nostoi Region. It has no Archon Quest.

New content: New weapon: Crimson Moon's Semblance (5-star Polearm). New artifact sets: Unfinished Reverie and Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy.

Areas: The Nostoi Region sits off the main Fontaine plate, so its waters cannot be dived into. The Sea of Bygone Eras is a separate map reached from the Faded Castle.

Story content: Arlecchino's quest follows an "aftershadow" in the House of the Hearth.

Placement: Follows 4.5 and precedes 4.7.

47.content:
Version 4.7: An Everlasting Dream Intertwined (also: Version 4.7, Genshin Impact 4.7, 4.7 update): Version 4.7, "An Everlasting Dream Intertwined", was released on 2024-06-05. It added Clorinde (5-star Electro Sword), Sigewinne (5-star Hydro Bow) and Sethos (4-star Electro Bow), and the Imaginarium Theater. It finished Archon Quest Chapter IV with Act VI, Bedtime Story.

New content: New weapons: Absolution (5-star Sword), Silvershower Heartstrings (5-star Bow) and Cloudforged (4-star Bow). No new region was added.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act VI: Bedtime Story. It follows three quests: Cold Case Commission, Memories That Should Not Exist and World-Order Narration.

Placement: Follows 4.6 and precedes 4.8.

48.content:
Version 4.8: Summertide Scales and Tales (also: Version 4.8, Genshin Impact 4.8, 4.8 update): Version 4.8, "Summertide Scales and Tales", was released on 2024-07-17. It added Emilie (5-star Dendro Polearm) and the limited-time summer event in Simulanka. It has no Archon Quest and is the last version before Natlan in 5.0.

New content: New weapon: Lumidouce Elegy (5-star Polearm). Emilie's Story Quest is Pomum de Ambra Chapter Act I - Floral Debt, Blood Due.

Event: Summertide Scales and Tales was a flagship event running from 2024-07-17 to 2024-08-28, set in the limited-time area Simulanka.

Placement: Follows 4.7 and precedes 5.0.

key: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
49.comment: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
49.content:
Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn (also: Version 5.0, Genshin Impact 5.0, Natlan release): Version 5.0, "Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn", was released on 2024-08-28. It opened Natlan, the Pyro nation, as a new nation, and began Chapter V of the Archon Quest. New characters were Mualani, Kinich and Kachina.

Release: Released 2024-08-28, between 4.8 and 5.1.

key: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
50.comment: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
50.content:
Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn (also: Version 5.1, Genshin Impact 5.1): Version 5.1, "The Rainbow Destined to Burn", was released on 2024-10-09. It added no new region. Its main content was Chapter V Acts III and IV of the Archon Quest and one new character, the five-star Geo Sword user Xilonen.

Release: Released 2024-10-09, between 5.0 and 5.2.

key: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
51.comment: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
51.content:
Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame (also: Version 5.2, Genshin Impact 5.2): Version 5.2, "Tapestry of Spirit and Flame", was released on 2024-11-20. It added three Natlan areas, the Interlude Archon Quest of Chapter V, All Fires Fuel the Flame, and two characters: Chasca, a five-star Anemo Bow user, and Ororon, a four-star Electro Bow user. It was also the first version to support Xbox Series X and S and Xbox Game Pass.

Release: Released 2024-11-20, between 5.1 and 5.3.

52.content:
Version 5.3: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection (also: Version 5.3, Genshin Impact 5.3): Version 5.3, "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection", was released on 2025-01-01. It added no new region. Its main content was Chapter V Act V, which ends the Natlan war, and three new characters: Mavuika (five-star Pyro Claymore), Citlali (five-star Cryo Catalyst) and Lan Yan (four-star Anemo Catalyst). It also gave the Traveler a Pyro form.

Release: Released 2025-01-01, between 5.2 and 5.4.

53.content: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams (also: Version 5.4, Update 5.4, Patch 5.4, Moonlight Amidst Dreams): Version 5.4, "Moonlight Amidst Dreams", was released on 2025-02-12. It added Yumemizuki Mizuki, a dream-eating baku who treats patients at the Aisa Bathhouse in Inazuma City, and her Story Quest "Dream Eater's Melancholia". It had no Archon Quest.

key: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
54.comment: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
54.content:
Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return (also: Version 5.5, Genshin Impact 5.5): Version 5.5, "Day of the Flame's Return", was released on 2025-03-26. It had no Archon Quest. It added two Natlan areas, Atocpan and the Ancient Sacred Mountain, and two characters: Varesa (five-star Electro Catalyst) and Iansan (four-star Electro Polearm).

Release: Released 2025-03-26, between 5.4 and 5.6.

55.content:
Version 5.6: Paralogism (also: Version 5.6, Genshin Impact 5.6): Version 5.6, "Paralogism", was released on 2025-05-07. It added no new area. Its main content was the Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act IV, also titled Paralogism, and two new characters: Escoffier, a five-star Cryo Polearm user, and Ifa, a four-star Anemo Catalyst user.

Release: Released 2025-05-07, between 5.5 and 5.7.

key: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
56.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
56.content:
Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You (also: Version 5.7, Genshin Impact 5.7): Version 5.7, "A Space and Time for You", was released on 2025-06-18. It added no new area. Its main content was Chapter V Act VI of the Archon Quest, set in Natlan, and two characters: Skirk (five-star Cryo Sword) and Dahlia (four-star Hydro Sword).

Release: Released 2025-06-18, between 5.6 and 5.8.

57.content:
Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort (also: Version 5.8, Genshin Impact 5.8): Version 5.8, "Sunspray Summer Resort", was released on 2025-07-30. It added the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, a summer-themed area, the prelude act of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, The Journey Home, the Lunar-Charged elemental reaction and one new character, the five-star Electro Polearm user Ineffa.

Release: Released 2025-07-30, between 5.7 and 6.0.

key: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue
58.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
58.content:
Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves (also: Version 6.0, Genshin Impact 6.0, Version Luna I, Luna I, Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue): Version 6.0, officially "Luna I" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue), was released on 2025-09-10. It opened the new region Nod-Krai and added Archon Quest Acts I-II, with the new characters Lauma, Flins and Aino.

Release: Released 2025-09-10, after 5.8 and before Luna II (6.1).

key: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise
59.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
59.content:
Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight (also: Version 6.1, Genshin Impact 6.1, Version Luna II, Luna II, Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise): Version 6.1, officially "Luna II" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise), was released on 2025-10-22 as "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight". It added no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Acts III and IV, the 5-star Dendro Catalyst Nefer and the open beta of Miliastra Wonderland.

Release: Released 2025-10-22, after Luna I (6.0) and before Luna III (6.2).

key: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude
60.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
60.content:
Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North (also: Version 6.2, Genshin Impact 6.2, Version Luna III, Luna III, Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude): Version 6.2, officially "Luna III" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude), was released on 2025-12-03 as "A Nocturne of the Far North". It added no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Acts V and VI, the Story Quest Draco Rubedo Chapter, and the characters Durin (5-star Pyro Sword) and Jahoda (4-star Anemo Bow).

Release: Released 2025-12-03, after Luna II (6.1) and before Luna IV (6.3).

key: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude
61.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
61.content:
Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night (also: Version 6.3, Genshin Impact 6.3, Version Luna IV, Luna IV, Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude): Version 6.3, officially "Luna IV" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude), was released on 2026-01-14 as "A Traveler on a Winter's Night". It added the Nod-Krai area The Lament of the Cliff-Shadowed Hollow, Archon Quest Acts VII and VIII, and the characters Columbina, Zibai and Illuga.

Release: Released 2026-01-14, after Luna III (6.2) and before Luna V (6.4).

key: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation
Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind update
62.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
62.content:
Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind (also: Version 6.4, Patch 6.4, Version Luna V, Luna V, Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation, Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind update): Version Luna V (numbered 6.4 on the wiki, with the Archon Quest subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation") was released on 2026-02-25, after Luna IV. It added Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, his first Story Quest and a Mondstadt homecoming event. It opened no new area.

Release: Released 2026-02-25. Previous: Luna IV. Next: Luna VI.

New content: Varka. Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I, "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition". Event: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo
63.content:
Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming (also: Version 6.5, Patch 6.5, Version Luna VI, Luna VI, Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo, Augured Homecoming update): Version Luna VI (numbered 6.5 on the wiki, with the Archon Quest subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo") was released on 2026-04-08, after Luna V. It added Linnea, the area Windrest Peak in northern Mondstadt and the sky realm Temple of Space. It had no Archon Quest.

Release: Released 2026-04-08. Previous: Luna V. Next: Luna VII.

New content: Linnea. Alcyon Chapter Act I, "Up! Toward Homecoming Wings". World quests including the "A Long Day in the Mountains" series.

key: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante
Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana version
64.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
64.content:
Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana (also: Version 6.6, Version Luna VII, Luna VII, Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante, Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana version): Version Luna VII (numbered 6.6 on the wiki), "Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana", was released on 2026-05-20 and is subtitled "Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante". It added Acts IX and X of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, which bring an Irminsul crisis to Sumeru and end it, and the playable characters Nicole and Prune, followed by Lohen in the second half. It opened no new area.

Release: Released 2026-05-20, between Version Luna VI and Version Luna VIII.

Characters: Nicole ("Clamor Within", a 5-star Pyro catalyst user of the Hexenzirkel), Prune ("Childlike Dreams Cherished", a 4-star Anemo catalyst user) and Lohen ("Sharpened Arrowhead", a 5-star Cryo polearm user and Knights of Favonius vice captain) were added.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo
65.content:
Version 6.7: Sunny Summer Fontinalia (also: Version 6.7, Version Luna VIII, Luna VIII, Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo): Version Luna VIII (numbered 6.7 on the wiki), "Sunny Summer Fontinalia", was released on 2026-07-01 with the subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo". It opened two new Nod-Krai areas, Dunanna Pit and the Frost Moon, added Sandrone as a playable five-star Cryo Claymore user, and brought a summer film-festival event in Fontaine. It had no Archon Quest.

Release: Released 2026-07-01, between Version Luna VII and 7.0.

66.content:
Version 7.0: Everwinter Without Mercy (also: Version 7.0, Genshin Impact 7.0): Version 7.0, "Everwinter Without Mercy", was released on 2026-08-12. It opened Snezhnaya, the Cryo nation, as a new playable region and began Archon Quest Chapter VII with Act I (Everwinter Without Mercy) and Act II (Wraith's Nocturne). It added Odette, a five-star Cryo Sword user, and Alyosha, a four-star Electro Polearm user, and the Traveler gained a Cryo form.

Release: Released 2026-08-12. New region: Snezhnaya, with Volkodlak Tundra, Everfrozen Earth, Fellfrost Peak, Flamefeather Valley and White Birch Snowgrave.

key: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld
67.comment: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld
67.content:
Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld (also: Version 7.1, Genshin Impact 7.1): Version 7.1, "A Rekviem for the Underworld", was released on 2026-09-23 and is the canon cutoff of this archive. The wiki lists no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Chapter VII Act III (White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking) and Act IV (A Rekviem for the Underworld), and two new five-star characters: Vesna, an Anemo Sword user, and Vodyanitsa, a Hydro Catalyst user.

Release: Released 2026-09-23, after 7.0. No new area.
